title: Maximum Sum Of 3 Non Overlapping Subarrays
description: Find three non-overlapping subarrays of length k with the maximum sum.
pseudocode:
1. Calculate window sums of length k
2. Compute left[i] as index of max sum window in [0...i]
3. Compute right[i] as index of max sum window in [i...n-k]
4. Iterate middle window from k to n-2k
5. Update result if sum(left[mid-k], mid, right[mid+k]) is greater
